timeToInteractive.description: Time to Interactive (TTI) - measures how long it takes for the page to become fully interactive
timeToInteractive.rationale: 2.5s threshold aligns with Google's 'Good' TTI score. Users perceive delays > 3s as slow.

firstContentfulPaint.description: First Contentful Paint (FCP) - when the first piece of content is rendered
firstContentfulPaint.rationale: 1.5s threshold aligns with Google's 'Good' FCP score. Critical for perceived performance.

largestContentfulPaint.description: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) - when the largest content element renders
largestContentfulPaint.rationale: 2.5s threshold aligns with Core Web Vitals 'Good' LCP score.

cumulativeLayoutShift.description: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) - measures visual stability
cumulativeLayoutShift.rationale: 0.1 threshold aligns with Core Web Vitals 'Good' CLS score.

firstInputDelay.description: First Input Delay (FID) - measures input responsiveness
firstInputDelay.rationale: 100ms threshold ensures app feels responsive to user interactions.

timeToFirstByte.description: Time to First Byte (TTFB) - server response time
timeToFirstByte.rationale: 600ms threshold allows for local Electron app IPC overhead.

main.rationale: 1.5MB limit ensures reasonable load times. Consider code splitting for larger bundles.

renderer.rationale: 1MB limit for renderer to keep Electron main process lightweight.

preload.rationale: 500KB limit for preload scripts which should be minimal.

css.rationale: 300KB limit with Tailwind CSS and component styles.

images.rationale: 500KB limit for images, use WebP with compression.

fonts.rationale: 200KB limit for fonts, consider system fonts fallbacks.

heapSize.rationale: 150MB limit prevents memory leaks from impacting UX.

jsHeapSizeLimit.rationale: 200MB based on typical Electron app constraints.

requests.description: Maximum number of network requests on page load
requests.rationale: 50 request limit reduces HTTP overhead and improves load time.

totalTransferSize.rationale: 3MB limit for initial page load including all resources.

timeToFirstByte.reason: Electron IPC adds overhead to local resource loading

bundleSize.reason: Web mode requires additional polyfills and compatibility code
